intervention_names: Dietary Supplement: extra virgin olive oil
arm_groups.label: olive group

brief_summary: Aim of this study to evaluate the effects of extra virgin olive oil on glycemic control ,insulin resistance and insulin secretion in patients with Type 2 diabetics.
brief_title: Extra Virgin Olive Oil on Glycemic Control ,Insulin Resistance and Insulin Secretion

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Patients with type 2 diabetes with

* age 30-60 years regardless of their gender.
* Duration of diabetes less than 5 years.
* on oral antihyperglycemic medication.
* willing to participate in research.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 diabetes.
* Insulin treated type 2 DM patients.
* Pregnant women .
* Patients on cholesterol-lowering drugs, steroids and other drugs that affect the fat metabolism.
* Patients on regular (days) supplement that contain olive oil.
* Patients have aversion or allergy to olive oil.
* Smokers .
* Patients have gall bladder disease ,gastrointestinal disease (e.g.malabsorption),liver,kidney,heart and thyroid diseases.

official_title: Effect of Extra Virgin Olive Oil on Glycemic Control ,Insulin Resistance and Insulin Secretion in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: change of HBa1c (glycated hemoglobin) after intervention by extra virgin olive oil
change of fasting glucose after intervention by extra virgin olive oil
